research.thesis_topic: Graph neural network models for drug-target interaction prediction and polypharmacy side-effect discovery using large-scale biomedical knowledge graphs

publications.title: Predicting Drug-Drug Interactions with Heterogeneous Biomedical Knowledge Graphs

projects.name: KG-DrugNet
projects.description: Implemented a relational GNN on a biomedical KG (Hetionet + DrugBank) to predict novel drug-target pairs. AUC 0.91 on held-out test, identified 3 potential repurposable candidates for Alzheimer's disease.

projects.name: Protein Function Annotation with Graph Attention
projects.description: Used Graph Attention Networks (GAT) on protein interaction networks from STRING DB to predict GO term annotations. Outperformed DeepGO on sparse protein families.
